desc: Ideation: reduce each person to a directed interval on prefix potentials and outline the pairwise conflict rules.
Validate the pairwise-conflict characterization with a small DSU/cycle oracle.
Implement the full sliding-window solution: transform intervals, maintain per-direction endpoint occupancy and same-direction segment trees, compute first_bad[L], and answer all queries.
Optimize the Python implementation for the constraints: fast I/O, iterative segment tree, low-overhead updates/queries, and careful edge-case handling.
Run the public sample tests and confirm the solution passes.
